primary_source.title: Deep One-Class Classification
primary_source.claim_boundary: Deep SVDD maps normal data toward a hypersphere center. It makes no P1 performance claim.

candidate_fingerprint: normal-prefix neural embedding compacted around a center; distance-to-normal-center anomaly score; add-only thresholded action

module.fingerprint: learned timestamp embedding followed by conditional normal-prototype distance

reason: Changing the embedding objective from hierarchical contrastive agreement to hypersphere compactness does not create a sufficiently independent P1 action family: both learn a normal embedding and threshold distance to a learned normal center/prototype. The prior TS2Vec normal-prototype lane already consumed this representation-action fingerprint and failed its coverage gate. A Deep-SVDD rerun would also repeat the repository's one-class normal-distance axis.
next_axis: non-contrastive redundancy-reduction pretraining with a supervised add-only head, only after a separate Barlow-Twins versus TS2Vec/SupCon/masked-reconstruction semantic audit
